nodes.rationale: People use this product to read long contracts. The interface should recede so clauses and citations stay legible.
nodes.summary: Keep the interface calm and readable for dense legal documents. Use text-sm or text-xs for chrome, comfortable line height, and full-viewport reading layouts. Do not add loud marketing sections, extra accent colors, or decorative motion.
nodes.title: Calm, high-readability UI

nodes.rationale: Inferred from the current split between lib/api.ts and lib/backend.ts. Confirm this remains the only data path.
nodes.summary: Client components read and write server data through TanStack Query and src/lib/api.ts. Do not fetch inside useEffect, and do not call FastAPI from the browser. Route handlers call FastAPI only through src/lib/backend.ts.
nodes.title: Client data goes through the BFF

nodes.rationale: Inferred from tailwind.config.ts and the workspace screens. Confirm before treating the palette roles as settled.
nodes.summary: Use the dark surface scale for page backgrounds and cards, parchment ink for text, and gold only for brand, citations, focus, and primary actions.
nodes.title: Dark surfaces with a gold accent

nodes.rationale: Inferred from the workspace disclaimer and the product mission. Confirm which routes must show it.
nodes.summary: Workspace screens keep a visible disclaimer that the product helps people understand their documents and is not legal advice. Use the disclaimer-bar class.
nodes.title: Comprehension disclaimer stays visible

nodes.rationale: Parallel widgets drift apart, especially tables, chat, and status badges.
nodes.summary: Reuse a component already in the graph before adding a new one. Prefer DocumentList, ChatPanel, WorkspaceChat, PdfViewer, ObligationList, ObligationsDashboard, and the shared classes btn-primary, btn-ghost, card, citation-chip, and disclaimer-bar when they cover the need.
nodes.title: Reuse existing components

nodes.rationale: One token set keeps the reading theme consistent, and the context graph can catch drift.
nodes.summary: Style UI only with tokens from tailwind.config.ts and component classes in globals.css (surface, ink, gold, status, font-display, font-sans, font-mono, shadow-gold, shadow-card, btn-primary, btn-ghost, card, and the other component classes). Do not use Tailwind palette colors, arbitrary font sizes, arbitrary spacing, hex, or rgb values.
nodes.title: Theme tokens only

nodes.rationale: Inferred from current headings, body copy, and citation chips. Confirm the role split.
nodes.summary: Use font-display (Fraunces) for titles, font-sans (Outfit) for interface text, and font-mono (JetBrains Mono) for citations, timestamps, and status metadata.
nodes.title: Display, sans, and mono roles
